records.question: 2018 年的 GMV 是多少？
records.sql_text: SELECT SUM(payment.payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order.order_id), 0) AS gmv FROM v_o_orders AS order JOIN v_o_payments AS payment ON order.order_id = payment.order_id WHERE NOT order.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND order.order_purchase_timestamp >= %(start_ts)s AND order.order_purchase_timestamp < %(end_ts)s LIMIT 1

gold.gold_sql:

WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2019-01-01'

records.question: 2017 年每个月的订单量是多少？
records.sql_text: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', v_o_orders.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp), 'YYYY-MM') AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT v_o_orders.order_id) AS order_cnt FROM v_o_orders WHERE v_o_orders.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND v_o_orders.order_purchase_timestamp >= %(start_ts)s AND v_o_orders.order_purchase_timestamp < %(end_ts)s GROUP BY date_trunc('month', v_o_orders.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', v_o_orders.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) ASC LIMIT 100

gold.gold_sql:
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt
FROM v_o_orders AS o
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

diffs: 列数不同：金标 2 / 预测 0

records.question: 各州 GMV 前十名是哪些？
records.sql_text: SELECT o.customer_state AS customer_state, SUM(p.payment_value) AS gmv FROM v_o_orders AS o JOIN v_o_payments AS p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY o.customer_state ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 10

detail.binding_disclosure: 时间基准固定为下单时间，金额取自支付流水

gold.gold_sql:
SELECT o.customer_state AS state,
       ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value), 2) AS gmv
FROM v_o_payments AS p
JOIN v_o_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY o.customer_state
ORDER BY gmv DESC
LIMIT 10

records.question: 各品类商品销售额（不含运费）前十名是哪些？
records.sql_text: SELECT p.product_category AS product_category, SUM(oi.price) AS item_gmv FROM v_o_order_items AS oi JOIN v_o_orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN v_o_products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY p.product_category ORDER BY item_gmv DESC LIMIT 10

detail.binding_disclosure: 商品金额取明细行 price，不含运费

gold.gold_sql:
SELECT pr.product_category AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS item_gmv
FROM v_o_order_items AS i
JOIN v_o_orders AS o   ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN v_o_products AS pr ON pr.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY pr.product_category
ORDER BY item_gmv DESC
LIMIT 10

records.question: 各州的配送延迟率是多少？
records.sql_text: SELECT o.customer_state AS customer_state, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS delivery_late_rate FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_status = %(status)s AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.customer_state ORDER BY delivery_late_rate DESC LIMIT 100

detail.binding_disclosure: 按订单归属，分子分母同一批 delivered 单

gold.gold_sql:
SELECT o.customer_state AS state,
       ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4
       ) AS delivery_late_rate
FROM v_o_orders AS o
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.customer_state
ORDER BY delivery_late_rate DESC
